name: In the Pursuit of Something Greater
source:
[b]Are you longing for something greater?[/b]

The oil is running in my veins… The precious substance that makes the world turn. No one remembers how beings like me were made, we… we’ve just started to exist I guess. There’s no record of our beginning. Were we sent by higher being? Were we experiments of some madman? No one knows. The only thing that matters is that our own blood kills us. Without The Resort we all would die. It’s like heaven for the Oil donors. They care about us, they do everything they can to allow us live like normal beings. In exchange we offer our blood-oil, the fuel for many machines. I heard that deep underground you can find strange creatures that feast upon our blood… We are truly a resource to be utilized…

It is peaceful life and we are safe here and… and I have enough of this. I spent here 40 years. The only things I saw was the plain walls of this building and the empty streets behind my windows. I want to leave… I want to leave so much… Even if I die down there… But I don’t want to die. I want to experience the outside world. Look what it has to offer. I can’t survive without The Resort… What should I do?

[From [url=https://strawberrynoodles.itch.io/in-the-pursuit]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[b]你渴望更伟大的事情吗？[/b]

石油在我的血管里流动……这是让世界运转的珍贵物质。没有人记得像我这样的生物是如何被创造出来的，我想我们……我们才刚刚开始存在。我们的开始没有任何记录。我们是高等生命派来的吗？我们是某个疯子的实验吗？没有人知道。唯一重要的是我们自己的血会杀死我们。没有度假村我们都会死。对于石油捐助者来说，这就像天堂。他们关心我们，尽一切努力让我们像正常人一样生活。作为交换，我们提供我们的血油，许多机器的燃料。我听说在地下深处你可以找到以我们的鲜血为食的奇怪生物……我们确实是一种可以利用的资源……

这是和平的生活，我们在这里很安全，而且……我已经受够了。我在这里度过了40年。我唯一看到的就是这座建筑朴素的墙壁和窗后空荡荡的街道。我想离开……我太想离开了……即使我死在那里……但我不想死。我想体验一下外面的世界。看看它能提供什么。没有度假村我就无法生存……我该怎么办？

[来自[url=https://strawberrynoodles.itch.io/in-the-pursuit]Itch.io[/url]]
